**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning to host a dinner party.

[EVENT] User recently attended a potluck dinner at a coworker's house last weekend.

[RELATIONSHIP] User has a coworker named Sarah, with whom they talked about their shared love of cooking.

[PREFERENCE] User is looking for recipe ideas for a dinner party that are easy to make and will impress guests.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested a 3-course menu for the dinner party.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Course 1: Appetizer - Grilled Peach and Prosciutto Bruschetta: Toasted baguette slices topped with caramelized grilled peaches, crispy prosciutto, fresh arugula, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Course 2: Main Course - Herbed Crusted Salmon with Roasted Vegetables: Fresh salmon fillets coated with a mixture of parsley, dill, lemon zest, and breadcrumbs, then baked. Alternative option: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms filled with sautéed spinach, garlic, and feta cheese.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Course 3: Dessert - Lemon Lavender Creme Brûlée: Rich and creamy lemon-lavender infused custard topped with a caramelized sugar crust.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested wine pairings: Dry Riesling for the bruschetta, Pinot Grigio for the salmon, and Moscato d'Asti for the creme brûlée.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended planning ahead and prepping in advance to minimize stress on the day of the dinner party.

[PREFERENCE] User loves the idea of the grilled peach and prosciutto bruschetta and the herbed crusted salmon.

[EVENT] User is planning to have around 8-10 guests for the dinner party.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided quantities for each course: 1 baguette, 4-5 peaches, 6-8 slices of prosciutto, 8-10 salmon fillets, 2 cups of heavy cream, etc.
